tutorial.table: Every seat's chips and current bet. **Opponents' cards stay hidden until the showdown**, and a seat that has given up is marked folded.
tutorial.hand: Your two cards and what they make. **Only months 1, 3 and 8 carry a gwang (bright)** - hanafuda's brights are months 1, 3, 8, 11 and 12, and 11-12 are not in a 20-card pack, so the top hand has exactly three forms: 38, 18 and 13.
tutorial.actions: Call (a check when nothing is owed), raise (three times per hand at most), or fold. **The weakest named pair still beats the strongest kkeut.**
tutorial.resetButton: The reset button starts a new game.
